# betterado_environment (Data Source)

Use this data source to access information about an existing Azure DevOps Environment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (Number) The ID of the environment to look up. Conflicts with name.
- `name` (String) The name of the environment. Conflicts with environment_id.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the environment.
- `id` (String) The ID of the environment.
